primary.position_rule: Evenly spaced eojeol starts at offsets >= min_context_chars; one identical Unicode prefix is reconstructed for all targets.
primary.normalization: Frozen FineWeb2 text is NFC-normalized and stripped; this script verifies and does not modify it.

morphology.morph_position_rule: For two evenly spaced sampled eojeols per document, select the middle internal Kiwi boundary and the nearest character gap strictly inside one Kiwi morpheme; retain only exact-cover analyses with a matched pair.

prefix_reconstruction: text[context_start:char_offset]; identical document text and Unicode offsets for every target, independently tokenized by each pinned tokenizer.
